title: Let Me Help

pre.en: Why does Lily offer to help at the end?
pre.zh: 最后 Lily 为什么又要来帮忙？
options: Chen asks her to set the table.
She wants to wash the dishes.

intro: 一段兄妹对话：上完一串夜班的 Lily 来哥哥家过周末，一进门就抢着干活，Chen 却坚持这回轮到他照顾妹妹。读的时候留意主动帮忙和请人做事的说法：Let me …、I'll …、Shall I …?、Could you …?——两个人都抢着说，谁也不让谁。

sentences.en: Nice flat!
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Right, where are your rubber gloves?
sentences.zh: 好了，你的橡胶手套在哪儿？

sentences.en: Let me wash those dishes first.
Absolutely not — you've just done four night shifts in a row.
sentences.zh: 想都别想——你刚连上了四个夜班。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: This weekend, I'm taking care of you.
Then I'll make the tea.
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Or shall I set the table?
You don't have to do anything.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Could you just sit down and put your feet up?
sentences.zh: 你就坐下来，把脚跷起来歇会儿，行吗？

sentences.en: You know I don't feel like sitting around.
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Mum used to make us share every chore, remember?
sentences.zh: 小时候妈让我们什么家务都分着干，记得吧？

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You used to do half of mine too.
sentences.zh: 我那份你也常常帮我干掉一半。

sentences.en: That's why I insist on cooking tonight.
sentences.zh: 所以今晚这顿饭非我做不可。

sentences.en: You? Cook?
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: You didn't use to know where the kitchen was!
sentences.zh: 你以前连厨房在哪儿都不知道！

sentences.en: People change.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Now be honest with me.
When did you last take it easy?
sentences.zh: 你上一次好好歇着是什么时候？

sentences.en: All right, I see your point.
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Can you keep a secret?
I'm exhausted.
I know.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Just give it a try — twenty minutes on the sofa.
sentences.zh: 就试一下——在沙发上躺二十分钟。

sentences.en: And you mustn't come into the kitchen.
I've found a great recipe online.
sentences.zh: 我在网上找了个特别好的菜谱。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: So, did you make up with Tom in the end?
sentences.zh: 对了，你最后跟 Tom 和好了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I apologised for the capital letters, and now he even washes his own pans.
sentences.zh: 我为那些大写字母道了歉，现在他连自己的锅都自己洗了。

sentences.en: Chen?
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: It's been twenty minutes, and the smoke alarm's beeping.
sentences.zh: 二十分钟到了，烟雾报警器怎么在嘀嘀叫？

sentences.en: Don't get up!
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Everything's under control.
The rice is just a bit… black.
In that case, let me help.
sentences.speaker: Lily

cards.note: 洗碗、打扫时戴的手套；rubber 是橡胶，也指橡皮擦（英式）。
单说 Absolutely! 是「当然！」；Absolutely not 是「绝对不行」。
to look after someone or something
cards.tip: 和第 12 课的 look after 意思接近；take care of 还能指「处理（事情）」：I'll take care of the bill。不带 of 的 Take care! 是告别语「保重」。
cards.example: My parents take care of our son on Fridays.

cards.note: to put plates, knives, forks and glasses on a table before a meal
to sit down and relax, often with your feet resting on something
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：put my feet up；不一定真的把脚翘起来，意思就是「放松休息」。
cards.example: After the release, I went home and put my feet up.

cards.zh: 想（做某事）；有心情（做某事）
cards.note: to want to do something at a particular moment
cards.tip: like 是介词，后面接 doing 或名词：feel like going out，不说 feel like to go。
cards.example: I don't feel like cooking tonight — let's order pizza.

cards.note: household chores 家务；也指让人觉得烦的例行小事：Ironing is a chore.
to say firmly that you will do something, or that something must happen
cards.tip: on 后面接 doing 或名词：insist on paying；也可以只说一句 I insist!（我坚持！）
cards.example: My manager insisted on paying for lunch.

cards.note: to tell someone the truth, even when it is difficult
to relax and not work too hard
cards.tip: 中间的 it 不能省；对着急的人说 Take it easy! 还有「别急、别激动」的意思。
cards.example: The doctor told me to take it easy for a week.

cards.zh: 明白某人的意思；觉得某人说得有道理
cards.note: to understand why someone thinks something, and accept that they may be right
cards.tip: 第 14 课是 Chen 认妹妹的理，这次轮到妹妹认哥哥的理；All right 开头，带点不情愿。
cards.example: I see your point — let's test it on older phones first.

cards.note: to not tell other people something that you have been asked not to tell
cards.tip: Can you keep a secret? 是说秘密之前的常用开场白；第 15 课的 keep it a secret 是「把某件事保密」。
cards.example: I'm terrible at keeping secrets, so don't tell me anything.

cards.note: to try doing something to see if it works or if you like it
cards.tip: 第 13 课是 I'll give it a try（我试试）；这里是劝别人：Just give it a try（就试一下嘛）。
cards.example: You've never used the new editor? Give it a try.

cards.note: to become friends with someone again after an argument
after a long time, or after a lot of problems
to say sorry for something you have done
smoke 是不可数名词「烟」，不说 a smoke；fire alarm 是火警警报。
电子设备发出的短促响声；名词也是 beep：Leave a message after the beep.
反义是 out of control（失控）；get sth under control 把某事控制住。
used to say what you will do because of the situation that has just been described
cards.tip: 接着对方刚说的情况来回应，放句首，后面加逗号。
cards.example: The meeting's been cancelled? In that case, I'll work from home.
